items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I think you and Andy Blakeney. Have you heard of Blakeney? No.

ctx.x: He should, I think he should hire you. Because it's, uh, it's, uh, every time where he went, I was somewhere else, and when I went there, he was going someplace else. Yeah. Well, I tell you, you said he should hire me.

Well, I think you and Andy Blakeney. Have you heard of Blakeney? No. He plays trumpet somewhat like, uh, you know, Bunk. Mm-hmm. And, uh, he's got him. You see they have an underground in L.A. Colored Thaws do.
